metadata.title: मणिपुर में नार्को आतंकवाद की सच्चाई क्या है | What is the truth of Narco terrorism | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In an effort to grasp the Kuki side of the ongoing violence in Manipur, we interviewed Mang Khongsai, a youth leader representing the Kuki tribe. The purpose of the interview was to gain insights into their perspective on the conflict between the Kuki and Meitei communities.
The youth leader addressed the accusation that Kukis are involved in poppy cultivation and arms trade, branding it as a serious allegation. He stressed the importance of verifying such claims through reliable sources and investigations.
Furthermore, the youth leader shed light on the perceived discrimination and marginalization experienced by the Kuki community at the hands of the dominant Meitei community. He suggested that these factors contribute to the resentment and tensions between the two groups.
This interview with the youth leader from the Kuki tribe provided a glimpse into the Kuki perspective on the ongoing violence in Manipur. It is important to note that this interview represents only one side of the conflict, and we will bring more interviews and ground reports to have a holistic understanding of the Manipur crisis.
